hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/bootstrap-remote.sh" ]; then exec bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/bootstrap-remote.sh"; fi; if [ -f "scripts/bootstrap-remote.sh" ]; then exec bash "scripts/bootstrap-remote.sh"; fi; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" ]; then echo "bootstrap: script not found in $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or ." >&2; fi'

sh -c 'H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$H" ] || [ ! -f "$H/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py" ]; then G=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$G" ] && [ -f "$G/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py" ]; then H="$G"; else H="."; fi; fi; if [ -f "$H/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py" ]; then if [ ! -d "$H/.paircoder" ]; then U="$H"; G=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$G" ] && [ "$G" != "$U" ] && [ -f "$G/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py" ] && [ -d "$G/.paircoder" ]; then H="$G"; echo "base_branch_guard.py: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$U has no payload, resolving .claude/hooks from cwd checkout" >&2; exec python3 "$H/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py"; fi; echo "base_branch_guard.py: refusing to exec -- no trusted .paircoder/ payload checkout found (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-<unset>} cwd=$(pwd))" >&2; exit 2; else if [ -z "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ]; then echo "base_branch_guard.py: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset, resolving .claude/hooks from cwd" >&2; elif [ "$H" != "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" ]; then echo "base_branch_guard.py: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} has no payload, resolving .claude/hooks from cwd checkout" >&2; fi; exec python3 "$H/.claude/hooks/base_branch_guard.py"; fi; else echo "guard base_branch_guard.py not found -- CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-<unset>} cwd=$(pwd)" >&2; fi'
